question: Dr. Tsering Landol, who was one of the recipients of the Padma Bhushan 2020 award, hails from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Tsering Landol **is an Indian **gynecologist **and one of the pioneers of women's health. 
 
• She hails from the Union Territory of **Ladakh**, India. 
 
• The Government of India awarded her the **fourth highest civilian honour** of the Padma
